card.name: Commas in neonatal symptom lists
card.fires_on: The comma after a symptom in a list of newborn problems, such as 'hypotension,' or 'vomiting,' in warnings about in utero drug exposure. Weaker hits appear partway through a name or number.

modes.label: Comma in infant observation list
modes.description: Comma after hypotension in the ACE-inhibitor warning on observing infants exposed in utero.
modes.example: Closely observe infants with histories of in utero exposure to enalapril maleate tablets for hypotension<<,>> oliguria, and hyperkalemia

modes.label: Comma in neonatal findings list
modes.description: Comma after vomiting in a list of reported clinical findings in newborns.
modes.example: temperature instability, feeding difficulty, vomiting<<,>> hypoglycemia, hypot

modes.description: Rare hits partway through a personal name or a numeric range.
